usage: icebath usage [-h] [--provider PROVIDER] [--json]

Fetch the configured provider's account limits (Codex 5h/weekly windows, plan, banked resets;
Anthropic OAuth windows; OpenRouter credits) — the same block the /usage slash command prints —
and exit. Exit code 1 when no credential is configured or the fetch fails.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --provider PROVIDER  Provider to query (default: the configured model provider)
  --json               Print one JSON document instead of the human-readable block
